pairs.l: 1 — I've got a lot of work to do, you'll have to go without me.
2 — Can't you possibly stay? I'll miss you terribly.
3 — You have to see the Batman movie, it's only on a few more days.
4 — You shouldn't feel bad about breaking up with Dan.
5 — Here's the essay. It's not perfect but it's the best I could do.
pairs.r: B — It's the best I could do.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (ne mogu doći, imam puno posla) = E (I'm not coming). Poruka 2 (ne odlazi, faliti ćeš mi) = D (Don't go). Poruka 3 (moraš vidjeti taj film, još ga prikazuju samo nekoliko dana) = F (Don't miss it). Poruka 4 (ne trebaš se osjećati loše zbog raskida) = A (Don't be sorry). Poruka 5 (esej nije savršen, ali je to sve što sam mogao/la) = B (It's the best I could do).

r6.exp: Serena kaže 'I thought he was really attractive' → zgodan/dobar izgled = B (good-looking).

r7.exp: Noah kaže 'come over to MY PLACE' i 'a couple of friends will be there' → bit će kod kuće (A). Komšija dolazi k njemu, ne on k komšiji.

r8.exp: 'Big enough for my baby sister, not me' → preveliko za bebu, premaleno za Laylu = B (too small za nju).

r9.exp: 'Now I'm able to KEEP IN TOUCH with all my friends wherever I am' → razlog kupnje je kontakt s prijateljima = A.

r10.exp: Liam kaže 'I have never tasted such delicious seafood risotto. You should try it' → preporučuje risotto = C.

r11.exp: Tekst kaže 'he became known as the Human Calculator' → nadimak je Human Calculator.

r12.exp: Sposobnost je otkrio sa 9 godina, a to je bilo prije 40 godina → sada ima 9 + 40 = 49 godina.

r13.exp: Tekst eksplicitno kaže 'He is an edutainer, a person who educates and entertains'.

r14.exp: 'His hometown in Canada' → Scott je iz Kanade.

r15.exp: Napisao je dvije knjige: Math Magic for Kids i Math Magic → 2.

r16.exp: 'Doesn't change the way you APPEAR, (16)____.' → C: but it does the way you FEEL (ali mijenja način na koji se osjećaš). Kontrast između vanjskog izgleda i unutarnjeg osjećaja.

r17.exp: 'Not only helps with communication, (17)____.' → B: but it also improves self-confidence. Struktura 'not only... but also'.

r18.exp: 'Once they develop their skills, (18)____. Taking part in conversations they used to avoid is not impossible any more.' → D: they become active in everyday communication.

r19.exp: 'Since some people mumble or cover mouths, (19)____. Everybody uses facial expressions and body language.' → F: other strategies have to be used (trebaju se koristiti druge strategije).

r20.exp: 'Although it takes time and patience, (20)____.' → E: its rewards are immense (nagrade su ogromne). Kontrast s 'although'.

r21.exp: 'We HAVE BEEN together for a month' — present perfect za radnju koja je počela u prošlosti i traje do sadašnjosti (for + period).

r22.exp: 'Before I COULD leave home' — modalni glagol 'could' u prošlosti (was able to). Kontekst je narativ o prošlim događajima.

r23.exp: '..., WHICH took me longer' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za ne-restriktivnu relativnu surečenicu (uz zarez).

r24.exp: 'I left late, SO I had to hurry' — 'so' izražava posljedicu (therefore/as a result).

r25.exp: 'Shoes don't FIT me' = cipele mi ne odgovaraju po veličini/obliku. 'Fit' = odgovarati (o odjeći/obući). 'Suit' = pristajati (stilu), 'match' = slagati se bojom.

r26.exp: 'You HAVE made loads of new friends' — present perfect: have + past participle.

r27.exp: 'I'd like to meet HIM' — osobna zamjenica u objektnom padežu za muški rod (Patrick = him).

r28.exp: 'I was wondering IF/WHETHER you'd like to come' — neizravno pitanje s 'if' ili 'whether'.

r29.exp: 'How ABOUT bringing Patrick?' — fiksni izraz za prijedlog/sugestiju: 'How about + gerund'.

r30.exp: 'Looking FORWARD to seeing you' — fiksni izraz: look forward to + gerund.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) što si radio/la prošlog ljeta, (2) gdje bi htio/la provesti idealni odmor i zašto, (3) s kim bi htio/la ići i zašto. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi).
